What it pins:

- Every table is headed `Sr. No. Scrip Name Symbol`, not `Company Name` — the layout the DQ-5.1
  gate mistook for a detached one (with `ind_prs22022016_2.pdf` and `ind_prs12082016.pdf`).
- The opening paragraph gives part A (Dividend Opportunities 50, NV20, Quality 30) and part C
  (Next 50, 100, 200, 500, Midcap 150, …) November 15, 2016 and part B (Alpha 50, High Beta 50,
  Low Volatility 50) October 24, 2016. Every tracked section is part C, effective 2016-11-15 —
  not 2016-10-24: Cairn India leaves Next 50 / 100 / 200 / 500; Havells enters Next 50 and 100
  (leaving Midcap 150); Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals enters 200, 500 and Midcap 150.
